business_problem: Arapahoe Libraries advances equity and innovation with Microsoft 365 Copilot
solution_summary: Arapahoe Libraries built a Microsoft-based workflow around Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, and Viva Engage because Arapahoe Libraries advances equity and innovation with Microsoft 365 Copilot. Source information is captured from frontline systems, documents, transactions, images, or conversations and then processed with cloud services that classify, summarize, model, or route the data for downstream use. The resulting records are stored in shared business or analytical systems and surfaced through apps, dashboards, or case workflows so staff can move from manual review to faster action while still keeping a governed human-in-the-loop process. This turns scattered data into an operational workflow rather than a static report, making the same platform useful for both daily execution and future scaling, and Arapahoe Libraries in Colorado works to continually adapt—not only to residents’ changing needs but also to emerging technologies.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365
solution_components.role: Grounds prompts in Microsoft 365 content so employees can summarize meetings and email, draft documents, and retrieve answers without leaving daily workflows.

solution_components.name: SharePoint
solution_components.role: Stores internal documents and knowledge that staff or assistants search to answer questions and standardize work.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Teams
solution_components.role: Hosts collaboration, meetings, and chat workflows where users consume summaries, updates, and shared operational context.

solution_components.name: Viva Engage
solution_components.role: Publishes searchable knowledge and Q&A content derived from longer internal documents for staff consumption.

data_flow: Source data is captured from frontline systems or content, processed by the Microsoft-based workflow, stored in a shared business or analytical layer, and then surfaced back to staff through apps, dashboards, or case-management experiences.
